The user wants to list all chain identifiers present in the provided PDB structure.
I will scan the PDB records to find the chain identifiers.
The chain identifier is in column 22 (1-based index) of the PDB ATOM/HETATM records.
Looking at the structure:
`ATOM      1  N   GLY A   1       2.357 ...` -> Chain A
`ATOM    165  N   PHE B   1     -13.545 ...` -> Chain B
`HETATM  405 ZN    ZN B 101      -0.555 ...` -> Chain B

So the chain identifiers are A and B.
The format requested is a comma-separated list.
FINAL: A, B
Checking if there are any other chains. The structure only has A and B.
